title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Neutralization of…
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 contain an OS Command Injection vulnerability due to improper neutralization of special elements. This flaw allows an unauthenticated local attacker to potentially execute arbitrary scripts, impacting confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
